in_hindi.name: नरवीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: Narashakti Vīr (possessing the power of the lord and being a hero)

in_tamil.name: நரவீர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Narāyaṇar Vīraṉ (one who is like Narayana, the supreme lord, and is a hero)

in_telugu.name: నరవీర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Narasakti Vīr (possessing the power of the lord and being a hero)

in_marathi.name: Narveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Man
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nar + Veer, where Nar means 'Lord' and Veer means 'Man'. This name is given to a boy born to be a brave and strong leader.

in_bengali.name: Narveer
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Man
in_bengali.long_meaning: Narveer একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nar + Veer, where Nar means 'Lord' and Veer means 'Man'. This name is given to a boy born to be a brave and strong leader.
